tests.id: does not reuse a cached client_id/client_secret registered with a different (portless) URI (P4-F2, AGUC-021)
keeps the previously stored client unchanged when the sign-in is denied (P4-F2, AGUC-021)
keeps the previously stored client unchanged when the token exchange fails (P4-F2, AGUC-021)
never persists the client itself on success — it only returns it alongside the tokens (P4-F2, AGUC-021)
savePlaneClientAndTokens persists client + tokens together, so a later refresh sends the matching pair (P4-F2, AGUC-021)
savePlaneClientAndTokens clears the previously stored refresh token when the new grant has none, so a token-less re-grant cannot leave it paired with the new client (P4-F2, AGUC-021)
surfaces a rejected refresh token as a human sentence, not a raw JSON blob (AGUC-021)
